notes: Consolidated KRW millions scaled to full won; USD convenience columns in reports are not used. FY2007–2009 K-GAAP;2010onward K-IFRS. Comparative years use next opened report, where available.

Net income is controlling interests / owners of the parent, not total profit. Equity uses directly printed parent-attributable subtotal / Total Shareholders equity; no subtraction of minorities or component summation. Where subtotal absent retain null.

capex is cash PP&E acquisition/purchases only, storednegative. Separate intangible-acquisition lines are not summed (company does not combine them). Cash flow is net total after interest/tax, not cash generated before those payments.
DilutedEPS is explicitly labeled in income statements. Pre2018per-share figures retain originalpre50-for-one2018split basis;2018onward post-split basis. No unsourced split adjustment made.
No aggregate debt, dividend-per-share, consolidatedemployees or closing ordinary shares were extracted; no sums of borrowings, dividend cash totals or issued-less-treasury calculations.

Prior years use the comparative values in the next opened audited report where available. restated is false unless an explicit accounting restatement was identified; a comparative column alone is not marked restated. Additional later restatements outside the paired opened sources have not been exhaustively audited.
